variables.release_start: DateTime; set only after the production QA window closes

query.name: 완료된 첫 페이지 0건 비율
query.query: WITH kinds AS (SELECT arrayJoin(['browse', 'search']) AS query_kind), filters AS (SELECT arrayJoin(['all', 'salad_poke', 'grilled_steamed', 'whole_grain', 'plant_based', 'rice']) AS filter), completed AS (SELECT properties.query_kind AS query_kind, properties.filter AS filter, count() AS completed_events, countIf(properties.result_count_bucket = '0') AS zero_events FROM events WHERE event = 'catalog_result_received' AND timestamp >= {variables.release_start} AND timestamp <= {variables.analysis_end} GROUP BY query_kind, filter), failures AS (SELECT properties.query_kind AS query_kind, count() AS error_events FROM events WHERE event = 'catalog_request_failed' AND timestamp >= {variables.release_start} AND timestamp <= {variables.analysis_end} GROUP BY query_kind) SELECT kinds.query_kind AS query_kind, filters.filter AS filter, coalesce(completed.completed_events, 0) AS completed_events, coalesce(completed.zero_events, 0) AS zero_events, coalesce(failures.error_events, 0) AS error_events, if(completed_events = 0, null, zero_events / completed_events) AS zero_rate, if(completed_events = 0, 'unavailable', 'available') AS status FROM kinds CROSS JOIN filters LEFT JOIN completed ON kinds.query_kind = completed.query_kind AND filters.filter = completed.filter LEFT JOIN failures ON kinds.query_kind = failures.query_kind ORDER BY query_kind, filter

query.name: 장소 열기에서 길찾기 30분 전환
query.query: WITH browser_places AS (SELECT distinct_id, properties.place_id AS place_id, countIf(event = 'place_opened') AS place_opened_events, countIf(event = 'directions_opened') AS directions_opened_events, arrayExists(opened_at -> arrayExists(directions_at -> directions_at >= opened_at AND directions_at <= opened_at + INTERVAL 30 MINUTE, groupArrayIf(timestamp, event = 'directions_opened')), groupArrayIf(timestamp, event = 'place_opened')) AS converted FROM events WHERE event IN ('place_opened', 'directions_opened') AND timestamp >= {variables.release_start} AND timestamp <= {variables.analysis_end} GROUP BY distinct_id, place_id), browser_rollup AS (SELECT distinct_id, sum(place_opened_events) AS place_opened_events, sum(directions_opened_events) AS directions_opened_events, max(converted) AS converted FROM browser_places GROUP BY distinct_id), totals AS (SELECT countIf(place_opened_events > 0) AS opened_browsers, countIf(place_opened_events > 0 AND converted = 1) AS converted_browsers, sum(place_opened_events) AS place_opened_events, sum(directions_opened_events) AS directions_opened_events FROM browser_rollup) SELECT opened_browsers, converted_browsers, place_opened_events, directions_opened_events, if(opened_browsers = 0, null, converted_browsers / opened_browsers) AS conversion_rate, if(opened_browsers = 0, 'unavailable', 'available') AS status FROM totals

query.name: 탐색 후 장소 열기 30분 비율
query.query: WITH browsers AS (SELECT distinct_id, countIf(event IN ('search_used', 'filter_selected')) AS discovery_events, arrayExists(discovery_at -> arrayExists(opened_at -> opened_at >= discovery_at AND opened_at <= discovery_at + INTERVAL 30 MINUTE, groupArrayIf(timestamp, event = 'place_opened')), groupArrayIf(timestamp, event IN ('search_used', 'filter_selected'))) AS acted FROM events WHERE event IN ('search_used', 'filter_selected', 'place_opened') AND timestamp >= {variables.release_start} AND timestamp <= {variables.analysis_end} GROUP BY distinct_id), totals AS (SELECT countIf(discovery_events > 0) AS discovery_browsers, countIf(discovery_events > 0 AND acted = 1) AS acted_browsers FROM browsers) SELECT discovery_browsers, acted_browsers, discovery_browsers - acted_browsers AS `후속 행동 미관측`, if(discovery_browsers = 0, null, acted_browsers / discovery_browsers) AS action_rate, if(discovery_browsers = 0, 'unavailable', 'available') AS status FROM totals

query.name: 14일 성숙 코호트 재방문 보조 신호
query.query: WITH browsers AS (SELECT distinct_id, minIf(timestamp, event = 'map_viewed') AS first_view_at, countIf(event = 'map_viewed') AS map_view_events, groupArrayIf(timestamp, event = 'place_opened') AS opened_at FROM events WHERE event IN ('map_viewed', 'place_opened') AND timestamp >= {variables.release_start} AND timestamp <= {variables.analysis_end} GROUP BY distinct_id), classified AS (SELECT distinct_id, map_view_events > 0 AND first_view_at + INTERVAL 14 DAY <= {variables.analysis_end} AS matured, map_view_events > 0 AND first_view_at + INTERVAL 14 DAY > {variables.analysis_end} AS immature, arrayExists(opened -> toStartOfDay(toTimeZone(opened, 'Asia/Seoul')) > toStartOfDay(toTimeZone(first_view_at, 'Asia/Seoul')) AND opened >= first_view_at AND opened <= first_view_at + INTERVAL 14 DAY, opened_at) AS returned FROM browsers) SELECT countIf(matured) AS matured_browsers, countIf(matured AND returned) AS returned_browsers, countIf(immature) AS immature_browsers, if(matured_browsers = 0, null, returned_browsers / matured_browsers) AS return_rate, if(matured_browsers = 0, 'unavailable', 'available') AS status FROM classified
